news_cards.title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting eight essential qualities
bullets: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlighting eight essential qualities: Pragnya, Sushilata, Damau, Shruta, Parakrama, Bahubhashita, Dhan, and Kritajnata.
These eight qualities brighten a person's life, with Pragnya showing the right path, Sushilata keeping character pure, and Damau keeping one disciplined.
The qualities are based on ancient Indian wisdom and are considered essential for building character and achieving success in life.

news_cards.title: Gautam Adani denies any deal linked to dismissal of U.S. criminal case
bullets: Gautam Adani denied any deal linked to the dismissal of the U.S. criminal case in a sworn affidavit.
Adani stated that he was unaware of any exchange connected to the decision and denied knowledge of any agreement.
The U.S. Department of Justice's move to dismiss the criminal indictment against Adani has raised questions about the nature of the deal.

news_cards.title: India demands accountability after embassy premises defaced in Slovenian capital
bullets: The Indian embassy premises in Ljubljana, Slovenia were defaced allegedly by anti-India elements.
The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) has taken up the matter strongly with Slovenian authorities.
The MEA has demanded accountability for the perpetrators behind the reprehensible act.

news_cards.title: RSS to hold all-India coordination meeting in Andhra Pradesh
bullets: The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) will hold its annual Akhil Bharatiya Samanvay Baithak in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.
The three-day meeting will bring together representatives of 32 organisations inspired by the RSS.
The meeting will be attended by national presidents, general secretaries, and other office-bearers of the organisations.

news_cards.title: History will remember Manmohan Singh kindly as most consequential PM: Sonia Gandhi
bullets: Congress leader Sonia Gandhi praised former Prime Minister Manmohan Singh for his record of integrity and accountability.
Gandhi stated that Singh's legacy will be remembered kindly by history as a quiet, gentle, but most consequential Prime Minister.
The Supreme Court's clean chit to Singh in the coal block allocation case has sparked a debate about his legacy.

news_cards.title: ‘Women aren’t birth machines’, CM Rekha Gupta defends Lakshmi Yojana
bullets: Chief Minister Rekha Gupta defended the Lakshmi Yojana scheme, which aims to empower women financially and improve their health.
Gupta stated that women should not be treated as 'machines for giving birth to children' and that family planning is a personal choice.
The scheme's eligibility conditions have been criticized by the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) for excluding women with more than three children.

news_cards.title: Full Vande Mataram to ring out from Red Fort for 1st time on Independence Day
bullets: The full rendition of Vande Mataram will be played at the Red Fort on Independence Day for the first time.
The decision was taken to promote national integration and patriotism.
The event will be attended by dignitaries and the public will be allowed to participate in the celebration.
